title: Fate and PPARgamma and STATs-driven effects of the mitochondrial complex I inhibitor tebufenpyrad in liver cells revealed with multi-omics.
authors: Leger, Thibaut; Balaguer, Patrick; Le Hegarat, Ludovic; Fessard, Valerie
one_liner_zh: 该文用多组学探究农药TEBU对肝细胞的影响，虽涉及PPARgamma和STATs转录因子及分子对接，但核心是毒理表型与代谢响应，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，方法以组学和报告基因为主，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The biological effects of the pesticide and mitochondrial complex I inhibitor tebufenpyrad (TEBU) on liver cells were investigated by combining proteomics and metabolomics. Both cell culture media and cellular lysates were analyzed in dose-response and kinetic experiments on the HepaRG cell line. Responses were compared with those obtained on primary human and rat hepatocytes. A multitude of phase I and II metabolites (>80) mainly common to HepaRG cells and primary hepatocytes and an increase in metabolization enzymes were observed. Synthesis of mitochondrion and oxidative phosphorylation complex constituents, fatty acid oxidation, and cellular uptake of lipids were induced to compensate for complex I inhibition and the decrease in ATP intracellular contents caused by TEBU. Secretion of the 20 S circulating proteasome and overall inhibition of acute inflammation followed by IL-6 secretion in later stages were observed in HepaRG cells. These effects were associated with a decrease in STAT1 and STAT3 transcription factor abundances, but with different kinetics. Based on identified TEBU targets, docking experiments, and nuclear receptor reporter assays, we concluded that liver cell response to TEBU is mediated by its interaction with the PPARgamma transcription factor.
abstract_zh: 通过结合蛋白质组学和代谢组学方法，研究了农药及线粒体复合物I抑制剂吡螨胺（TEBU）对肝细胞的生物效应。在HepaRG细胞系上，对细胞培养基和细胞裂解液进行了剂量反应和动力学实验分析。将响应与原代人肝细胞和大鼠肝细胞的结果进行了比较。观察到大量I相和II相代谢物（>80种），主要存在于HepaRG细胞和原代肝细胞中，且代谢酶水平升高。线粒体和氧化磷酸化复合物组分的合成、脂肪酸氧化以及细胞对脂质的摄取被诱导，以补偿TEBU引起的复合物I抑制和细胞内ATP含量下降。在HepaRG细胞中，观察到20S循环蛋白酶体的分泌以及急性炎症的总体抑制，随后在后期出现IL-6分泌。这些效应与STAT1和STAT3转录因子丰度的降低相关，但动力学特征不同。基于已鉴定的TEBU靶点、对接实验和核受体报告基因分析，我们得出结论：肝细胞对TEBU的响应由其与PPARgamma转录因子的相互作用介导。
